name: compatibility-check
title: Compatibility check
description: Answer "will it fit?" for cases, filters and spare parts: pick a brand and a model and get compatible, not compatible with alternatives, or unknown, never a guess.
docs: Give it brands, models (each with the id of its brand) and the ids the product fits in compatible. Pass incompatible too when you know which models it does not fit: a model on neither list is then reported as unknown, instead of being guessed at. alternatives (by model id) are listed under a not-compatible answer, and contactHref adds an ask-us link to the unknown one. onCheck receives the brand, the model and the verdict whenever both are chosen: store that and pass it back as defaultValue to remember the last choice. productName is the subject of a sentence ("Halcyon MagGrip car mount fits the Orbit One."), so keep it singular or change the wording with labels. Until a brand is chosen the model field is disabled, and a line of text under it says why. fit.ts holds verdictFor and runs on the server too.
